answer: Require each identity to earn standing through verified joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent builds one island of attested tasks over time, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. A prism view of who vouched for whom, anchored at one vertex of checked history per identity, lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
